text: [1] "I am the true vine, [2] and my Father is the vine grower. [AA]
He takes away every branch in me that does not bear fruit, and every one that does he prunes [3] so that it bears more fruit.
You are already pruned because of the word that I spoke to you. [AB]
Remain in me, as I remain in you. Just as a branch cannot bear fruit on its own unless it remains on the vine, so neither can you unless you remain in me.
I am the vine, you are the branches. Whoever remains in me and I in him will bear much fruit, because without me you can do nothing.
[4] [AC] Anyone who does not remain in me will be thrown out like a branch and wither; people will gather them and throw them into a fire and they will be burned.
If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask for whatever you want and it will be done for you. [AD]
By this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit and become my disciples. [AE]
As the Father loves me, so I also love you. Remain in my love. [AF]
If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, just as I have kept my Father's commandments and remain in his love. [AG]
"I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and your joy may be complete. [AH]
This is my commandment: love one another as I love you. [AI]
[5] No one has greater love than this, [AJ] to lay down one's life for one's friends.
You are my friends if you do what I command you.
I no longer call you slaves, because a slave does not know what his master is doing. I have called you friends, [6] because I have told you everything I have heard from my Father. [AK]
It was not you who chose me, but I who chose you and appointed you to go and bear fruit that will remain, so that whatever you ask the Father in my name he may give you. [AL]
This I command you: love one another. [AM]
[7]"If the world hates you, realize that it hated me first. [AN]
If you belonged to the world, the world would love its own; but because you do not belong to the world, and I have chosen you out of the world, the world hates you. [AO]
Remember the word I spoke to you, [8] 'No slave is greater than his master.' If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours. [AP]
And they will do all these things to you on account of my name, [9] because they do not know the one who sent me. [AQ]
If I had not come and spoken [10] to them, they would have no sin; but as it is they have no excuse for their sin. [AR]
Whoever hates me also hates my Father. [AS]
If I had not done works among them that no one else ever did, they would not have sin; but as it is, they have seen and hated both me and my Father. [AT]
But in order that the word written in their law [11] might be fulfilled, 'They hated me without cause.' [AU]
"When the Advocate comes whom I will send [12] you from the Father, the Spirit of truth that proceeds from the Father, he will testify to me. [AV]
And you also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning. [AW]
